concerns.text: Multi-format generation endpoints should enforce streaming or background generation for larger documents to prevent thread pool exhaustion under concurrent load.
Ensure chat session synchronization robustly handles network disconnects and localStorage quota limits.
Verify WCAG 2.1 AAA color contrast ratios across both light and dark theme modes on all mobile viewports down to 375px.
Ensure search input debouncing and reactive query filtering remain fully responsive without UI regressions across mobile viewports.
